title: Runpod Worker Ollama
description: A serverless Ollama Worker for Runpod

input.name: Context Length
input.description: Tokens of context (prompt + generation). Ollama's own default is 4096 and it silently DISCARDS the front of any longer prompt rather than erroring. Image default is 8192. Each 1024 tokens costs ~0.16 GiB of preallocated VRAM on top of ~13.9 GiB of weights, multiplied by OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL.

input.name: Max Concurrency
input.description: Maximum number of concurrent requests to handle (default: 8)

input.name: Parallel Requests
input.description: Ollama slots served concurrently. KV cache is OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH x this, so raising it multiplies VRAM. Image pins it to 1 for predictable memory; only raise it if the GPU is sized for it.
